job.title: Principal Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

A commerce platform for thousands of merchants needs engineers who know how commerce software is extended, deployed and run – I have done that on enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Platform extensions and headless APIs in Java/Spring
– CI/CD release cycles on CCv2, Docker, Kubernetes
– Query refactoring that reduced response latency

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for shopware.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Senior Platform Engineer | E-Commerce Platforms, Java, APIs, CI/CD & Kubernetes
tailoring.summary: Senior e-commerce platform engineer with 5+ years building, extending and running enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices and platform extension points (Interceptors, Populators, Converters). Hands-on with CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Jenkins, SQL performance tuning and production troubleshooting. Performs code reviews and mentors junior developers in international, agile teams. Uses AI-assisted development daily.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: shopware is one of Europe's leading open commerce platforms, and its platform team shapes how thousands of merchants build their shops. I want to bring my view from the enterprise commerce side – extensibility, APIs, deployment and performance – to the platform itself, in a product company based in Germany.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Platform Engineer role caught my eye: 5+ years extending, deploying and running enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Based in Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Happy to talk!

en.subject: Application: Principal Platform Engineer
en.hook: A commerce platform used by thousands of merchants needs engineers who know what it takes to extend, deploy and run commerce software at scale. I have done exactly that for more than five years on enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell: platform extensions in Java and Spring, headless APIs, release cycles in the cloud and production troubleshooting.

bullets.label: Platform extension
bullets.text: Customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters and implemented functionality following platform best practices and design patterns on Hybris 2211.

bullets.label: APIs at platform level
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts and third-party consumers; built RESTful APIs for PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Delivery & operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows; supported production troubleshooting.

bullets.label: Engineering excellence
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency; code reviews and technical guidance for junior developers.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at shopware on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
